impact: Two false item-8 on-screen verification runs. apps/desktop/vite.config.ts pinned port 1420 with strictPort:true for every agent, so this cycle's vite could not bind and 'tauri dev' attached to a SIBLING worktree's dev server (wf_924a22ca-f35-19): this agent's Rust backend (38 new core_rulebook companions, all present) painted by another tree's frontend source (no CRB book label). The screenshot would have been evidence about a tree this agent does not control. driver.sh's prior mitigation was to kill -9 whatever held 1420, i.e. clobber the sibling's app, so both available outcomes were wrong.
